pedagogical_review.notes: Objectives align with formal application-operation/idempotency notation, a runnable finite Service Layer, ten distinct examples, and five complete exercises spanning trace, operation design, god-service diagnosis, architecture comparison, and high-stakes transfer.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
